title: DN80 Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp
seoTitle: DN80 EN14420-3 Pump Clamp | Pinjin Xingtai
description: The Xingtai clamp on this page is stamped EN14420-3, DN80, PN10/16, 3″/89, with a hinge, grease nipple and two-hole base. Other diameters are quoted after the pipeline. No list price and no small-batch shipping. It is not the DN200 elbow.

answerBlock.what: DN80 Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp is a pipeline fastening spare part manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. The piece is stamped EN14420-3, DN80, PN10/16 and 3″/89, with a hinge, tightening bolt, grease nipple and a two-hole base. Other diameters are quoted after the pipeline. No list price. Not sold in small batches.
answerBlock.who: Teams clamping a DN80 / 3″ line, after quantity and the pump pipeline are confirmed.
factors: Stamp is DN80 / PN10/16, not a marketplace PN25 claim
Electric 20 prints 80 mm pipe; this page does not print a fit certificate pairing the two SKUs
The DN200 elbow is a different diameter
No list price

faqs.question: What is stamped on the DN80 clamp?
faqs.answer: EN14420-3, DN80, PN10/16 and 3″/89, plus a hinge, grease nipple and two-hole base. Other diameters are quoted after the pipeline. No list price is printed.

faqs.question: Can this DN80 clamp close the DN200 elbow?
faqs.answer: The site does not print that pairing. The clamp page is DN80. The elbow page is DN200. They are separate SKUs. Confirm diameter before quoting.
